claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.Process_ArrivedDestination (0x0600509F) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 545-byte body. It resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(TargetPlIdx), tests the returned object through MemberRef 0x0A00002A op_Implicit, and returns when that test is false. It then loads Referee.NextState and dispatches through an exact ten-entry switch after subtracting raw 9, so only raw NextState values 9 through 18 enter case bodies. Raw 9 calls Start_FallCount. Raw 15 calls Start_SubmissionCheck. Raw 18 calls Start_HandlingDisturbing. Raw 12 and 14 share one body that first writes State=12, overwrites State=14 only when NextState is raw 14, recomputes PlDir through DecideRefereeDir(TargetPlIdx), requests RefAnmTbl[12 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_3Dir[PlDir]], then writes FrameWait = FoulWaitCnt[RefePrm.foulCount]. Raw 11 writes State=11, requests RefAnmTbl[12 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_3Dir[PlDir]], and writes FrameWait = OutWaitCnt[RefePrm.outCount]. Raw 13 writes State=13, requests the same raw-12/3-dir table expression, and writes FrameWait = FoulWaitCnt[RefePrm.foulCount]. Raw 16 writes State=16; only when the resolved Player.Zone field is zero does it recompute PlDir through DecideRefereeDir(TargetPlIdx), then it requests RefAnmTbl[47 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_2Dir[PlDir]]. Raw 10 writes State=10, recomputes PlDir, requests RefAnmTbl[12 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_3Dir[PlDir]], and writes FrameWait=50. Raw 17 writes State=17, recomputes PlDir, and requests RefAnmTbl[47 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_2Dir[PlDir]]. Any switch default returns without those case effects. FACT-0084 pins the direct call from Process_MoveToDestination at IL+0x0053.
